selection_scope: Contract-preserving test/metadata correction only; no donor production source copied, no new production algorithm or runtime integration layer.

commons_collections.contract: M3ApacheBag explicitly retains min(ownedCount,inputCount), consistent with cardinality wording in the pinned Bag interface.
commons_collections.comparison: Pinned HashBag removes a key when retained input count exceeds the owned count. Unconditional implementation parity conflicts with the explicit M3 contract.
commons_collections.selected: Keep M3 owner unchanged; consume independent input occurrences to derive the expected retain result; keep real HashBag comparisons on the equivalent domain and add an explicit owned2/input3 divergence fixture.
commons_collections.rejected: Changing M3 to reproduce the pinned HashBag quirk; skipping excess-multiplicity input; allowing a diverged donor state to contaminate later random operations.
commons_collections.complexity: Independent fixture occurrence budget may take O(n*m) time and O(m+n) space for small bounded test states. It deliberately does not clone the production counted algorithm; no runtime speed claim.

spring.contract: Both adapters preserve caller-provided fixed-size list behavior and may throw UnsupportedOperationException when an add operation attempts to grow it.
spring.selected: Execute both counterparts for the three void add branches; compare RuntimeException class or successful null outcome; preserve all seeded operations, return/state checks, and fixed-list inputs.
spring.rejected: Copying fixed-size inputs into mutable lists, suppressing errors, discarding failing operations, changing production semantics, or retaining the larger all-operations Outcome helper.
spring.complexity: Only test observation changes; one execution of each donor/owner operation. No production complexity change or measured performance claim.
